# Ali's Barber Shop

> Barbershop in Pinellas Park, Florida specializing in skin fades, taper fades, line-ups, beard trims, and hot towel shaves. Arabic and English spoken. Book online at https://alisbarbershop.com

Ali's Barber Shop is a barbershop located in Pinellas Park, FL, serving Pinellas Park, Lealman, and the greater St. Petersburg area. The shop specializes in men's haircuts and precision fade work, beard grooming, and traditional hot towel shaves. Appointments can be booked online through the website, or by phone or text.

## Business details

- **Name:** Ali's Barber Shop
- **Address:** 4201 62nd Ave N, Unit 9, Pinellas Park, FL 33781, United States
- **Phone:** +1-813-895-9229 (call or text to book)
- **Email:** alisbarbershop2026@gmail.com
- **Website:** https://alisbarbershop.com
- **Languages spoken:** English, Arabic
- **Price range:** $$
- **Areas served:** Pinellas Park FL, St. Petersburg FL, Lealman FL

## Hours

- Sunday: 9:00 AM – 3:00 PM
- Monday–Friday: 9:00 AM – 9:00 PM
- Saturday: 9:00 AM – 7:00 PM

## Services

Haircuts, skin fades, taper fades, line-ups and edge-ups, beard trims and beard grooming, and hot towel shaves. The full, current service list with pricing and appointment durations is shown in the booking section of the website — prices are managed live and are not duplicated here.
